entities.summary: Hisila Yami, also known by her nom de guerre Parvati, is a Nepalese politician belonging to Pragatisheel Loktantrik Party and architect. She was a deputy chairman of Nepal Socialist Party and a former president of the All Nepal Women's Association (Revolutionary).
